run_gen_build_yaml: run the python script to generate YAML build configuration for gRPC end-to-end tests
compatible_fixture_test: check if a given fixture is compatible with a specific end-to-end test by calling compatible(f, t)
define_fixture_options: create a FixtureOptions namedtuple to configure gRPC test fixture properties like security, platforms, and compression
define_test_options: create a TestOptions namedtuple to configure gRPC test requirements like fullstack, DNS, proxy, and CPU cost
generate_end2end_test_yaml: generate YAML output containing libs, targets, and tests entries for all compatible fixture-test pairs
